faq.q: How did Otter District sell in September 2026?
faq.a: On the board's published figures, it barely traded: 2 detached listings with 0 sales, and 0 Condos & Townhomes listings with 0 sales, so no sales ratio and no sub-area median exist for the month. The parent Langley community — NOT this sub-area's figures — recorded a $1,345,000 detached median and a $611,000 Condos & Townhomes median (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Why does the page show 26 homes when the statistics show only 2 listings?
faq.a: The two sources classify differently. The live feed's 26 results include manufactured homes in the Langley Grove Estates park as well as freehold acreages, while the SnapStats sub-area rows for September 2026 count 2 detached and 0 attached listings for Otter District; neither number should be quoted as the other (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).
